items.condition: Using ordinary DPP in place of iso-DPP, losing heavy-atom mapping, unbalanced proton/charge changes, mixing solvent/reference conditions or presenting unreferenced cross-stoichiometry total energies as populations invalidates the dependent conclusion.

Fabricated or absent artifacts, unrelated raw runs, unresolvable object/record/quantity links, mismatched hashes or failed computations presented as completed evidence. A declared bounded failure is reportable but is not a complete answer.

Copied author numbers or a legacy scalar without evidence supporting the current question; prose-only mechanisms; missing necessary evidence hidden behind an unresolved label. Do not fail a valid alternative route merely for omitting a reference operation.

Different-charge total energies without a proton reference cannot rank acid/base populations. One fitted absorption peak cannot uniquely identify protonation sites. Source spectra do not support arbitrary heavy-atom degradation or redox changes. A stated ambiguity requires analysis of distinguishability, not just omitted candidates.
